input.rationale: There is no pricing MFN anywhere in the Agreement (Articles V-VIII contain only the tiered per-trade fee table, and the Revisions clause at p0094 favours us). However, Article XXII imposes a most-favoured-offer/right-to-match mechanic on us: we must disclose any bona fide third-party offer for our assets or a merger and give Licensor five business days to take that offer on those terms. Under the playbook, a right-to-match or most-favoured-offer mechanic is assessed under MFN. It fails every fallback element - it is not confined to a defined product, it runs for the entire term (36 months plus a potential seven-year renewal at Licensor's option), and it has no like-for-like comparison carve-out - so we take the preferred position and remove the Customer-side obligation, conforming the two follow-on sentences that operated off the deleted mechanic so no dangling defined terms remain.

proposal.summary: Remove the Licensee-side obligation in Article XXII to disclose third-party offers and let Licensor match them, and conform the two follow-on sentences.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We removed the Article XXII obligation to notify Licensor of third-party offers and let Licensor take them, since our playbook does not accept a most-favoured-offer or matching right in the Vendor's favour, and we conformed the two follow-on sentences that referred to the deleted mechanic.

ops.newText: ARTICLE XXII NO RIGHT OF FIRST REFUSAL The Licensor shall have no right of first refusal, no right to match, and no other right to be notified of or to receive any terms that the Licensee offers to or receives from a third party.
